observations: The two DOS7_CONFIG trial objects have one dsk_init public provider, in msdisk, and msbio2 defines both volume-label symbols locally.
Reassembling both unmodified and trial source without DOS7_CONFIG yields byte-identical object files for each module.
limitations: This checks the two objects and these specific symbols only; other BIOS objects or generated providers may still introduce conflicts.
Object equality is an isolated DOS6 compatibility check, not proof of a complete DOS6 link.
Final target BIOS layout, all relocations and original source ownership remain unverified.
